items.title: What is malware?
items.response: Malware is software made to damage or take control of computers. In high school cybersecurity, students learn how malware works so they can protect systems and keep information safe.

items.title: What is cybersecurity?
items.response: Cybersecurity is the practice of defending computers, networks, and data from attacks. It includes safe coding, passwords, encryption, and finding vulnerabilities before attackers do.
